description: Historical Prisma 2 migration workflow must be retrievable alongside current Prisma migration guidance.

input.query: Prisma ORM 2.12.0 legacy Prisma Migrate commands: prisma migrate save --experimental and prisma migrate up --experimental; compare with current prisma migrate dev and prisma migrate deploy.

referenceFacts.claim: Legacy Prisma Migrate workflows used prisma migrate save --experimental to create a migration.
Legacy Prisma Migrate used prisma migrate up --experimental to apply saved migrations.
Current Prisma migration workflows use commands such as prisma migrate dev for development and prisma migrate deploy for deployment.
